content.context: Phase 3 closure on master. Phase 3 code commit pushed fast-forward to origin (GitLab) and github (GitHub); both remote master refs were verified equal. Generated session artifacts are intentionally left untracked. Architecture-reference docs were excluded from the commit.
content.decision: Keep .pitmry canonical records as the source of truth; expose complete explicit state conflicts without letting inferred similarity create relationships.
content.rationale: Explicit subject-key conflicts must remain inspectable even when lexical or vector ranking returns only one side. The context response keeps its existing conflict ID field stable while adding serialized conflict records. Security audit was scoped to this repository lockfile; the earlier blocker came from auditing the parent workspace lockfile, not this project.
